prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph inside a small restaurant just before dawn. An unmistakably adult woman is hand lettering the day's menu on the interior surface of the front glass window. Use the supplied portrait only as guidance for her visible adult facial appearance and hair: a chin-length black bob with a soft wispy fringe, dark eyes, softly rounded facial features, and natural lips. She wears a dark apron over a pale shirt. She stands close to the window on the restaurant side. Her right hand holds a white paint marker; the nib touches the glass at shoulder height and a fresh opaque stroke continues from its tip into the final loop of the large hand-lettered word TODAY. Her right elbow remains slightly bent and visible from shoulder to wrist. Her left hand rests on the deep wooden sill below at waist height, beside a folded wiping cloth. Frame her from mid-thigh upward, placing the painted letters on the left and her face on the right. Use a slightly diagonal camera position inside the restaurant so the marker nib, fresh paint, and glass thickness read together. The letters are readable to customers inside. Through the transparent unpainted glass, a quiet blue pre-sunrise street and parked bicycle remain visible; a warm pendant lamp inside the restaurant appears as a weaker reflection layered on the pane. Cool transmitted daylight shapes one side of her face while the warmer lamp grazes the marker and fresh paint. The white paint sits on the near glass surface with a slightly raised wet edge. A soft, directionally coherent shadow from her arm falls across the wooden sill. Keep a faint wiped streak just above the cloth, attached to the pane rather than the street view. Preserve natural skin texture, textured apron fabric, and realistic glass transmission and reflection. Here the adult subject remains identifiable at environmental portrait scale; the place has visible task-specific fixtures or objects in the window menu, sill, cloth, and pendant lamp; the subject's action or position connects to those fixtures at the marker's contact point; the frame retains enough surrounding space to explain the task.
negative_en: fake-looking background, plastic-looking skin, broken facial features, illustration look, 3D render look, broken window geometry, excessive HDR, impossible perspective, cartoon style
